column1: A strong recent example is Target’s 2023 Pride collection backlash. Target did well initially by offering inclusive products and defending its values. The challenge was managing intense pressure from opposing sides — including safety threats to employees — while maintaining brand consistency. I would have advised leadership to scenario-plan before launch
column3: and avoid reactive removal of products. Instead
column4: they should have communicated a consistent principle
column6: and engaged both internal and external stakeholders transparently. That would have reduced the perception of caving to pressure while protecting the brand’s long-term integrity.
